<span class="hl-kw">from</span> __future__ <span class="hl-kw">import</span> annotations
<span class="hl-kw">from</span> dataclasses <span class="hl-kw">import</span> dataclass


<span class="hl-comment">@dataclass(frozen=True)</span>
<span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData:
    names: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>]
    scores: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">float</span>]
    counts: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">int</span>] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    flags: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">bool</span>] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    maybe: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span>] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>

    @classmethod
    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> from_dict(<span class="hl-kw">cls</span>, data: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]) -&gt; UserCreatedData:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">cls</span>(
            names=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;names&quot;</span>),
            scores=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;scores&quot;</span>),
            counts=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;counts&quot;</span>),
            flags=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;flags&quot;</span>),
            maybe=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;maybe&quot;</span>),
        )

    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> to_dict(<span class="hl-kw">self</span>) -&gt; <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> {
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;names&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.names,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;scores&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.scores,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;counts&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.counts,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;flags&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.flags,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;maybe&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.maybe,
        }
